deploy-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PIN: runtime v2.12 pinned for model-group 'embed-flex' in us-east-2. Trigger: sudden spike in embedding mismatch errors + elevated 5xx (link: https://ops/alerts/1725201234). CC @kayla @ryan

kayla: saw the alert. mismatch rate ~0.8% starting ~11:08 UTC. correlated with SDK 1.9.0 canary rollout at 10:50.

ryan: logs show new batching heuristic in sdk 1.9.0 changed padding behavior; embedding post-processing expects fixed-length vectors -> mismatch when backend returns trimmed vectors. runtime v2.12 enforces new strict contract.

linda: mitigation idea: route embedding requests with header x-embed-mode=flex to runtime v2.11 which tolerates trimmed vectors. can we do header-based routing?

deploy-bot: Available actions (ops role required):

```
/deploy pin runtime v2.12 --model embed-flex --region us-east-2 --until 2024-05-20T16:30Z --reason "embed mismatch after sdk 1.9.0"
/deploy route add --from runtime:v2.12 --to runtime:v2.11 --region us-east-2 --match "header:x-embed-mode=flex"
/deploy canary pause sdk 1.9.0
```

kayla: applied header-route. quick verification: embedding mismatch count for flex mode dropped to 0 in last 5m. overall 5xx trending down.

ryan: i'll open an SDK patch to restore backward-compatible padding behavior and add explicit contract tests. PR: https://git/repo/pull/9001. plan: revert canary, ship patch, then staged unpin.

linda: propose soft-unpin window 02:00 UTC (low traffic). staged ramp: 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m gates. rollback triggers: mismatch rate > 0.2% OR 5xx > 5 in 10m OR p95 latency > baseline+40%. auto-rollback should route to v2.11 and notify #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: Note: pin enforced. To request immediate unpin: `/deploy unpin runtime v2.12 --region us-east-2` (requires eng-releases approval).

kayla: drafting internal release note: "Temporary pin of runtime v2.12 in us-east-2 for embed-flex due to embedding length contract change with SDK 1.9.0; requests with x-embed-mode=flex routed to v2.11 until SDK patch. Customer-facing impact: some embedding consumers may have seen mismatched vector lengths; mitigation applied." will post to #release-notes-draft.

ryan: follow-ups: 1) patch PR and canary revert, 2) add contract tests in CI for embed length/padding, 3) capture gate snapshots for each ramp. I can own 1 & 2.

linda: i'll own the soft-unpin runbook and run gates. ping me if auto-rollback triggers.

devops-bot: Reminder: spare capacity in us-east-2 dedicated pool (2 nodes) if we need to shift traffic for testing. Use `infra allocate` if required.

kayla: thanks team. update this thread with PR links and gate metric screenshots. close when fully unwound and postmortem published. :lock:
